l: Don't worry about Honza and the others. They will be safe with us.
Fools, the lot of them. If they love magic so much, they should have tried being born a Bearer.
Criminals and cowards who bullied the desperate and the dispossessed into doing their bidding.
So thank you. I'd offer you a share in the spoils—if it didn't all belong to other people...
Speaking of which, I have rather an important negotiation to attend to. I must forget about the skies and begin my preparations.
As for me, well, my home is with the Crimson Caravans, and that's where I'll stay.
When we fled our childhood home, we left behind not only our family fortune, but the names our parents gave us. I became Eloise, and my brother, Theodore.
I loved him... And I shall continue his work. Our work.
Did I tell you that I found a map of Kasjlok among Theo's things?
That was what he wanted—an end to the torment that Bearers the realm over have long been forced to endure. A new beginning.
No matter how hard it might be, or how long it might take, I will make his dream a reality.
It is our job to keep the hope alive. If we don't, who else will?
You and I have more in common than you might think. Not only are we both masters of the blade—and devilishly handsome to boot—but we are both the second people to bear our respective names.
What? You didn't think "Ruzena Dalimil" was my own invention, did you? It was the name of my master. I inherited it from her, along with her title, and her smithy.
Alas, she was to leave my life as suddenly and unexpectedly as she had entered it...
Still, I suppose there's enough of me to go around. But do forgive me if the Desert Hare isn't always at your beck and call, won't you?

Ours is a blessed corner of the Velkroy—a veritable oasis, with clear, running water, and natural hot springs. I don't doubt that people have been gathering here since long before the founding of the republic.
At least, they did until Kupka built that castle of his at the heart of the Mothercrystal. Dalimil has been Titan's fiefdom since then...
So you see why those with the people's best interests at heart took it upon themselves to organize their own protection—my predecessor chief among them.
How very fitting that the noble soldiers of Dhalmekia and Waloed, partners in arms on so many battlefields, should also become partners in crime.
That was your doing, was it not? Rumors of the Fang's destruction have already reached the long ears of the Desert Hare, and they will soon be on the lips of every man, woman, and child in Dalimil.
My comrades and I have been keeping a watchful eye on the dark clouds in whose shadow we find ourselves—and the vultures that trail in their wake.
And defend Dalimil we shall. The only outlaw who'll be setting foot in this town is my good friend Cid.
Proof, if any more were needed, that Dalimil is much changed—and entirely for the better. Do not fear for us, Clive. We'll be alright!
But something tells me those brutes would rather starve than accept charity willingly offered...
I swore that I would avenge her. That my own life was a small price to pay if it might help me to end her murderer's.
And that's who I'll be, and how I'll live, until I draw my dying breath...provided no one discovers my other terrible secret... Ahem.
Whoever would have imagined it? Dalimil, the first town in the Twins to make a Bearer its mayor.
Well, we no longer have the Akashic problem in Ceratina to worry about, at least.
Everyone was delighted to hear it, and volunteered their help right away. Everyone apart from Viktor, that is.
The realm may have changed, but her people remain the same—ever driven by their appetites—many of which we here at the Veil are happy to sate.
I fancy yours, meanwhile, might be a little too tight. Perhaps one of my girls could help you with that...
Before there was Northreach, there was the wall—a last line of defense shielding the capital and her farmsteads from anyone foolish enough to try and claim them.
Alas, everything that was once worth guarding has either been packed off to the south, or lost to the floods, leaving our brave boys to languish in idleness, defenders of naught.
Not everyone left the capital when the emperor ordered his throne carted off to the Dominion, but enough departed to change the empire for good.
It went by in a flash...
In a few short moons, Oriflamme and Northreach went from being the crown of the empire and the ermine around its neck, to a veritable ball and chain.
The Veil does what it can, but our patrons' hearts are heavy, and many are quick to anger—occasionally, and most vexingly, at the expense of my poor girls...
It went by in a flash...
But even as our boys flourish under new leadership, others flounder for the lack of it.
I intend to keep supporting them.
There are so many questions, and I do not pretend to have the answers. I do, however, have the means to provide the poor boys a pleasant distraction, and for now, that will have to suffice.
I hate to admit it, but...
mata kao wo mise ni kite
Well, I think it safe to say we showed the Duke of Naught the error of his ways. The problem with so many leaders of men is that they know little of the men they wish to lead.
Yes, despite the duke's many failings—which are divers and plenty, mind you—I believe his love for the empire, and his desire to see it endure in these, its darkest of days, are sincere.
And who knows, in time, we may yet allow him to add "Duke of Northreach" to his list of titles.
クライヴ  ありがとう
The last few years have been anything but kind to Northreach, yet we've managed to endure in spite of it all. With a little help, of course.
Hope. Hope that tomorrow might be a better day.
And should the skies grow even darker, we will not fret, for we know we can overcome anything so as long as we stand together.
The night my family was taken
What do you make of that?
イーストプールのこと…
But the imperials couldn't have that, could they?
クライヴ  聞いとくれ
And it en't just the Bearers
When I was a little girl
Put the wind right up us
Like being back in the glory days
And we're just down here if they ever need us.
It en't exactly a bed of roses
これからも見といてくれ
Had you told me back in Rosalith that I'd one day be in charge of my very own village, I'd have thought it a jest—and a poor one at that. But here I am, nonetheless.
I still have a long way to go.
So that's what I'm doing now...or trying to, at least. Fortunately, Martha's always close by should I need her...which is more often than I'd like to admit.
Eastpool is the duchy, and in restoring the village, we begin to restore the country. It all starts here.
Driving back the horde was easy. But now comes the hard part—surviving.
彼らは知らないのです
Not that they're lazy, of course! Quite the opposite. It's just that they're going to need some time to learn the basics before they're ready to man a storehouse or stable.
そんなある日のことです
Eventually though, we were found...though not by the emperor's men, but your Uncle Byron. I still remember his words...
And while he has yet to lend his axe, he has always been most generous in his patronage, despite the considerable risk inherent in our association.

If we are to heal, we can no longer simply guard the flame of our forebears...but fan it, that it might spread to the hearts of all our brothers and sisters. And then...then the duchy shall truly rise again.
Well, I ain't the cook, am I? Though if you've tasted Kenneth's brown, I might as well be...
You got anything that needs repairing or retooling, you bring it here—along with your own materials. And any scraps left over, I keep.
Well, you won't hear me compaining.
Ew. Things here ain't too bad
Still, that don't mean I intend on doing it again.
クライヴ  待っておるぞ
But he's still with us, too
聞いたよ  お疲れさん
Must've been hot, fighting in the belly of that crag. Might be work for you as a smith when you hang up the old sword.
I know how hard it can be, trying to fill another man's boots—but I reckon you've grown into Cid's nicely. He'd be proud.
Yet the tale is far from over
As to why she has stayed away
頼んだぞ  クライヴ
バイロン・ロズフィールド卿…
Good bloody riddance. If there was ever a man who deserved a rusty knife in the gut, it was that prick. Not that I'd let you carry around a rusty knife.
How is this going to turn out...
I have said it many times
But what of the twins themselves?
クライヴ  聞いてくれ
It was luck and luck alone
But when I close my eyes
Fretting about the skies won't help me get my work done.
Unless, that is, they fancy giving me a hand shoeing the birds.
Oh. The blighted thing float, did it?
Clever girl, that one. A right boil on the arse sometimes...but clever all the same.
The sound of ringing steel has filled the streets of Dravozd since back before anyone can remember.
And who knows? Maybe some day my prentice'll be someone else's master...and work them just as hard as I do him.
Crack the crystal. Kill a god. Save the world. I miss anything?
Not a very good one, if you ask me.
ああ  ディオン殿下…
I don't mean to be gloomy
クライヴ  頼んだぜ！
they need all the help they can get
誰も死なないでほしい
I don't want anyone to die.
It was the greatest honor of my life
皆様のお役に立てればと
きっとジョシュア様も…
いいかい  クライヴ
ありがとう  カローン
Truth is but a matter of belief
And if it weren't for Cid
I'll leave that to you to decide. I'm sure you're more than capable of choosing the perfect moniker for Cid's right-hand man.
ええ  お願いします
There's no one like our Nan
ディオン・ルサージュ…
クライヴ  ありがとう
We'll make it, I know we will.
This is the last one, isn't it?
Somewhere, in the back of my mind
Enjoy her while you can, Clive
You better bloody had do and all!
No sooner have your wounds mended
そうではなく  この私
はあ  ジョシュア様…

風の大陸北東に位置するザンブレク皇国は
かねてより その国土を黒の一帯に蝕まれていた
The Holy Empire of Sanbreque, located in the northeast of the Storm continent, had long had its territory eaten away by the Blight.

Long though Sanbreque's dominion over northeastern Storm has endured,
recent days have seen the Blight wrest ever more land from her grasp.
kaze no tairiku hokutou ni ichi suru zanbureku koukoku ha / kaneteyori sono kokudo wo kuro no ittai ni mushibama reteita

そのため 新たな領土を求めて
海を挟んだウォールード王国と長く争いを続けている
For this reason, seeking new territory, it has long been at war with the Kingdom of Waloed across the sea.

For which reason she has continued to wage war on her rival across the strait,
hoping to claim less blackened pastures.
sonotame arata na ryoudo wo motome te / umi wo hasan da uooruudo oukoku to nagaku arasoi wo tsuzuke teiru
ところが  相手は召喚獣オーディンを擁する強国
However, the opponent was a mighty nation that commanded the Eikon Odin.
But Odin would sooner pawn his sword than Waloed relinquish Ash.
tokoroga aite ha shoukan kemono oodin wo yousu ru kyoukoku

そう易々と領土を奪えるわけもなく
事態は進展していなかった
It was not as though territory could be seized so easily, and the situation had made no progress.
And the empire pays dearly for every blade of grass bent beneath Sanbrequois boots.
sou yasuyasu to ryoudo wo ubae ruwakemonaku / jitai ha shinten shiteinakatta

そこでザンブレクの神皇シルヴェストルが目をつけたのは
豊富な資源を抱えるクリスタル自治領だ
So the Holy Emperor of Sanbreque, Sylvestre, set his sights on the Crystalline Dominion, a land rich in resources.

Little wonder, then, that Sylvestre set his sights on the Crystalline Dominion—
an altogether easier target, possessed of no less aether.
sokode zanbureku no jinnou shiruvesutoru ga me wotsuketanoha / houfu na shigen wo kakae ru kurisutaru jichiryou da

君たちがマザークリスタル・ドレイクヘッドの破壊に
動いていた裏で 一挙にかの地へ侵攻 制圧した
While you were working to destroy the Mothercrystal, Drake's Head, they invaded that land behind your backs and conquered it in one stroke.

...while you were busying yourself with the destruction of Drake's Head,
that the empire made its move, subjugating its theretofore neutral neighbor.
kun tachiga mazaakurisutaru・doreikuheddo no hakai ni / ugoi teita urade ikkyo nikano chi he shinkou seiatsu shita
だが  クリスタル自治領は  文字通り“世界の中心”
But the Crystalline Dominion is literally the "center of the world."
A nation which could legitimately claim to be the center of the world.
daga kurisutaru jichiryou ha mojidoori “ sekai no chuushin ”
最大の地理的要衝でもある
It is also the most vital strategic position of all.
Certainly, there is no better place to stage an army.
ここを押さえれば  ヴァリスゼア統一にも手が届くだろう
With this place under control, even the unification of Valisthea would be within reach.
From there, the Holy Empire's reach spans the Twins.
kokowo osa ereba varisuzea touitsu nimo tega todoku darou

だからこそ 各国は相互牽制として
不可侵条約を結んでいたのだが――
That is precisely why the nations had concluded a non-aggression treaty to keep one another in check...

The non-aggression treaty was the only thing keeping them in check,
but if they truly broke the pact without provocation...
dakarakoso kakkoku ha sougo kensei toshite / fukashin jouyaku wo musun deitanodagaaa
一方的に破られたとなれば  紛糾は避けられん
If it were broken unilaterally, conflict would be unavoidable.
...it is only a matter of time before others reply in kind.
ippouteki ni yabura retatonareba funkyuu ha sake raren
And, of course, our friends in Haearann.
それぞれが生き残りをかけ  乱世は加速しているよ
Each stakes its survival, and the age of chaos is accelerating.
Who will be left standing, I wonder, when the last drop of blood is spilled.
sorezorega ikinokori wokake ransei ha kasoku shiteiruyo

鉄王国――それは ヴァリスゼアの西部島嶼を
領土としている宗教国家だ

The Iron Kingdom... it is a religious state
whose territory is the western islands of Valisthea.

As you know, the Iron Kingdom rules over the islands to the west of Storm—
or rather, its church does.
tetsu oukokuuu soreha varisuzea no seibu tousho wo / ryoudo toshiteiru shuukyou kokka da

だが 同じ宗教国家でも
ザンブレクが宗教を政に利用するのとは異なる

But though it too is a religious state,
it differs from Sanbreque, which uses religion in its politics.

But this is not the pragmatic approach to state religion employed by the Holy Empire
to manipulate the masses.
daga onaji shuukyou kokka demo / zanbureku ga shuukyou wo matsurigoto ni riyou surunotoha kotonaru

鉄王国は それ自体が
国家の基盤となっているのだからな

For in the Iron Kingdom, religion itself
is the foundation of the state.
No, the Iron Kingdom is the literal embodiment of the Crystalline Orthodoxy.
tetsu oukoku ha sore jitai ga / kokka no kiban tonatteirunodakarana
《クリスタル正教》――それが  かの国の根幹
The Crystalline Orthodoxy... that is the root of that nation.
And so, if one is to understand it, one must start there.
<< kurisutaru seikyou >>>> sorega kano kuni no konkan

クリスタル正教は
マザークリスタルを聖なるものと崇めている

The Crystalline Orthodoxy reveres
the Mothercrystal as sacred.
As the name implies, the orthodoxy holds the Mothercrystals sacred.
kurisutaru seikyou ha / mazaakurisutaru wo hijiri narumonoto agame teiru

故に その一部をクリスタルとして切り出すばかりか
ただの道具に貶めるような魔法の使用を禁忌とした

Therefore, it forbade not only carving out pieces of it as Crystal,
but also the use of magic, which would reduce it to a mere tool.
And they do not take kindly to heathens plundering the objects of their worship for the means to fill washtubs and light lamps with frivolous feats of magick.
yueni sono ichibu wo kurisutaru toshite kiridasu bakarika / tadano dougu ni sagesume ruyouna mahou no shiyou wo kinki toshita

信徒どもに言わせれば
エーテルは穢れであり 毒というわけさ

Ask the faithful and they will say aether is impurity...
poison.
Indeed, the faithful consider aether a sinful thing. A poison, no less.
shinto domoni iwa sereba / eeteru ha kegare deari doku toiuwakesa

その毒を食らい 魔法を行使するドミナントを
兵器として扱っているのも特徴のひとつだろう

Another defining trait is that they treat Dominants,
who consume that poison and wield magic, as weapons.

And to them, a Dominant is an instrument of evil—
albeit one they have proven only too happy to turn against their enemies.
sono doku wo kura i mahou wo koushi suru dominanto wo / heiki toshite atsukatsu teirunomo tokuchou nohitotsudarou
Some eighty years ago, in northern Storm—

風の大陸北方のマザークリスタル・ドレイクアイの消滅を機に
北部諸国とロザリア公国が衝突した

With the disappearance of Drake's Eye, the Mothercrystal in the north of the Wind Continent,
the northern nations clashed with the Grand Duchy of Rosaria.

Drake's Eye collapsed. Soon after, in pursuit of aether, and with the Blight at their backs,
the Northern Territories descended upon the Grand Duchy of Rosaria.
kaze no tairiku hoppou no mazaakurisutaru・doreikuai no shoumetsu wo kini / hokubu shokoku to rozaria koukoku ga shoutotsu shita
この大規模な戦の陰で  鉄王国は公国領を侵犯するに至る
In the shadow of this great war, the Iron Kingdom came to encroach upon the duchy's territory.

And when the Shields of the Flame marched north to meet them,
the Iron Kingdom spied an opportunity.
kono daikibo na sen no in de tetsu oukoku ha koukoku ryou wo shinpan suruni itaru

ドレイクブレスを抱くドルスタヌス島――
ロザリア最大の聖地を実効支配する形でね

Drustanus Island, which holds Drake's Breath...
Rosaria's greatest holy site... came under their effective control.

A few short days later, the Crusaders landed on the island of Mt. Drustanus—
home of Drake's Breath—and plucked it from the duchy's grasp.
doreikuburesu wo daku dorusutanusu shimaaa / rozaria saidai no seichi wo jikkou shihai suru katachi dene

公国側の抵抗も虚しく…クライヴ 君が物心つく頃には
もはや遠征以外で立ち入れぬ地になっていたはずだ

Even the duchy's resistance proved in vain... Clive, by the time you were old enough to understand,
it must already have become a land you could not enter except on campaign.

Rosaria tried to reclaim it, of course, but to no avail. I doubt more than a handful of
duchy men have set foot on its shores in your lifetime.
koukoku gawa no teikou mo munashi ku… kuraivu kun ga monogokoro tsuku goroni ha / mohaya ensei igai de tachiire nu chi ninatteitahazuda

そして ロザリアが滅んでからは
ドレイクブレスは完全に鉄王国のものとなった

And after Rosaria fell,
Drake's Breath became entirely the Iron Kingdom's.

Nor are they like to again, under the empire's stewardship.
Meaning the Ironblood will keep their island.
soshite rozaria ga horon dekaraha / doreikuburesu ha kanzen ni tetsu oukoku nomonotonatta

時を経て ついに奴らは
大陸進出の足がかりとなる要所を手に入れたというわけだ

In time, they finally secured
a key position that would give them a foothold for their advance onto the continent.

And with it, the foothold they need to march on
mainland soil when next they spy an opportunity.
toki wo hete tsuini yatsu raha / tairikushinshutsu no ashi gakaritonaru yousho wo teniire tatoiuwakeda
まずは  フーゴ・クプカという男について
First, about the man Hugo Kupka.
Let us begin with the story of Hugo Kupka.

奴の正式な肩書は
《ダルメキア共和国評議会経済顧問》

His official title is
"Economic Advisor to the Council of the Dhalmekian Republic."

Or the "permanent economic advisor to the Dhalmekian government,"
to give him his formal title.
yatsu no seishiki na katagaki ha / << darumekia kyouwakoku hyougikai keizai komon >>

商業経済に重きを置くあの国において この肩書きは
金と権力 双方を握る地位にあることを意味している

In that country, which places such weight on commerce and economy,
this title means a position that wields both wealth and power.

In a republic founded on commerce, there could hardly be a more influential position.
It has granted him both extraordinary wealth, and extraordinary power.
shougyou keizai ni omoki wo oku ano kuni nioite kono katagaki ha / kin to kenryoku souhou wo nigiru chii niarukotowo imi shiteiru

それに加え 召喚獣タイタンのドミナントとして
国家防衛の切り札でもあるのだから すべては奴の欲しいがままさ

And on top of that, as the Dominant of the Eikon Titan,
he is also a trump card of national defense, so everything goes as he pleases.
Not that he ever wanted for the latter. Being Titan's Dominant, he is also Dhalmekia's last line of defense—a fact he has used to his considerable advantage.
soreni kuwae shoukan kemono taitan no dominanto toshite / kokka bouei no kirifuda demoarunodakara subeteha yatsu no hoshii gamamasa
フーゴはその権勢を振るい  国家の要衝ドレイクファングを掌握
Hugo wielded that influence and took control of Drake's Fang, a vital strategic point for the nation.

Why, he was even able to pry Drake's Fang—one of the pillars of the republic—
from parliament's grip.
fuugo hasono kensei wo furu i kokka no youshou doreikufangu wo shouaku

その結果 ドレイクファング守備隊はあっという間に買収され
フーゴの忠実なる私兵になり果てたというわけだ

As a result, the Drake's Fang garrison was bought off in no time at all,
and ended up as Hugo's loyal private army.

And he was quick to buy the loyalty of the Fang's protectors.
Today, they are his faithful creatures—a private army in all but name.
sono kekka doreikufangu shubitai haattoiu mani baishuu sare / fuugo no chuujitsu naru shihei ninari hate tatoiuwakeda
今回  ロザリアに進軍したのは彼奴らだろう
This time, it was likely those men who marched on Rosaria.
The selfsame army that marches upon Rosarian soil as we speak.
konkai rozaria ni shingun shitanoha kare yatsu radarou

知ってのとおりロザリアは
現在 ザンブレク皇国の属領だ
As you know, Rosaria is currently a vassal state of the Sanbreque Empire.
By which I mean imperial soil—not that you need reminding of the fact.
shitte notoori rozaria ha / genzai zanbureku koukoku no zokuryou da

しかし宗主国ザンブレクといえば クリスタル自治領で
ダルメキア共和国とにらみ合いの真っ最中 当然――
But its suzerain, Sanbreque, is currently locked in a standoff with the Dhalmekian Republic in the Crystalline Dominion, so naturally...

Suffice it to say, the empire's attentions are elsewhere at present,
deadlocked as it is with Dhalmekia over its occupation of the Crystalline Dominion.
shikashi soushukoku zanbureku toieba kurisutaru jichiryou de / darumekia kyouwakoku tonirami ai no makoto tsu saichuu touzennn
兵力は自治領に集めたい
They want to gather their forces in the Dominion.
heiryoku ha jichiryou ni atsume tai

そんな折 ドレイクブレスの消滅によって
鉄王国は大陸進出の拠点を失陥

At around that time, the disappearance of Drake's Breath
cost the Iron Kingdom its foothold for expansion onto the continent.

Scarcely a handful of garrisons remained to secure its western provinces—
and half of them left after the fall of Drake's Breath.
sonna ori doreikuburesu no shoumetsu niyotte / tetsu oukoku ha tairikushinshutsu no kyoten wo shikkan

つまり 西の憂いは解消され
海上防衛に注力する必要もなくなった

In other words, the concern in the west was resolved,
and there was no longer any need to focus on naval defense.

With the threat of the Ironblood thus diminished,
they had little cause to fear a maritime invasion.
tsumari nishi no urei ha kaishou sare / kaijoubouei ni chuuryoku suru hitsuyou monakunatta

ザンブレクはすぐさま 海軍も含めた
ロザリア駐屯軍の多くを自治領に回したよ
Sanbreque immediately reassigned much of the Rosaria garrison, including the navy, to the Dominion.

And so, today, only a token force guards the former duchy's shores—
as Kupka was quick to descry.
zanbureku hasugusama kaigun mo fukume ta / rozaria chuuton gun no ooku wo jichiryou ni mawashi tayo

フーゴはこの機を逃さず
警備が手薄な海路からロザリアに兵を進めたのさ

Hugo did not let this chance pass him by,
and advanced his troops into Rosaria along the thinly guarded sea route.
He landed his troops on the Rosarian coast without encountering so much as a single ship.
fuugo hakono ki wo nogasa zu / keibi ga teusu na kairo kara rozaria ni hei wo susume tanosa
奴の狙いは  クライヴ――

事実 フーゴの手勢はほかに目もくれず
ロザリス城ただ一点を狙っているのだから

In fact, Hugo's men pay no mind to anything else,
and their sights are set on a single point: Rosalith Castle.

And so he and his men advance upon Rosalith: not to capture the province,
but to draw you out.
jijitsu fuugo no tezei hahokani me mokurezu / rozarisu shiro tada itten wo neratsu teirunodakara

フーゴ・クプカは手勢を引き連れ
海路からロザリアへと入った

Hugo Kupka led his troops
into Rosaria by sea.
It is known that Kupka's forces entered Rosaria via its unguarded coast.
fuugo・kupuka ha tezei wo hiki tsure / kairo kara rozaria heto itsutsu ta
